name: duopore-public-subscription-renewal-calendar
description: See upcoming subscription renewals and the last dates to give notice.

interface.longDescription: See upcoming subscription renewals and the last dates to give notice. Enter renewal dates, notice periods and monthly or yearly costs. Get a dated list showing days left and the yearly cost based on your figures. It uses one renewal date per subscription. It does not check contract terms, send reminders or cancel subscriptions.
defaultPrompt: List my subscription renewal dates and notice deadlines.
What is the yearly cost of these monthly subscriptions?
